statement: Nvidia-backed neocloud Lambda is in talks for a pre-IPO round of up to $3 billion at a valuation of $12 billion or more, months after borrowing $917 million for chips.
why: A marginal GPU buyer is still able to raise large equity and chip-backed debt, which sustains its ability to keep ordering accelerators.

impact.mechanism: Fresh pre-IPO equity plus prior chip-purchase debt funds continued GPU procurement by a neocloud operator, feeding merchant-GPU demand.

evidence.excerpt: Nvidia-backed AI cloud provider Lambda is in talks to raise up to $3 billion in a pre-IPO financing round that could value the company at $12 billion or more

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet restating a Bloomberg report; talks are ongoing and deal terms are not finalized, and no filing corroborates.
